name: Katalon Studio
description_en:
Katalon Studio is the test-authoring IDE within Katalon’s broader True platform. It supports recorded and scripted automation for several application types, while hosted execution, management and production-session features belong to separately described products or entitlements.

This profile follows a proposed web test from project creation and recorded objects through assertions, failure handling and the choice of local, command-line or cloud execution. The distinction matters for both behavior and licensing. No installation, account, demo request, test, credential, CI run or subscription was operated.
description_zh:
Katalon Studio 是 Katalon True 平台中的测试编写 IDE，支持多类应用的录制及脚本自动化。托管执行、管理及生产会话相关功能属于另行说明的产品或权益。

本文沿拟定网页测试评估项目创建、录制对象、断言、失败处理，以及本地、命令行或云执行选择；这些区别同时影响行为及许可。本次未操作安装、账户、演示请求、测试、凭据、CI 运行或订阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Author tests with recorded objects and editable steps.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用录制对象及可编辑步骤编写测试。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose whether an error stops, continues as failed or continues with a warning.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择错误时停止、保留失败继续或以警告继续。

core_features.explanation_en: Use Katalon Runtime Engine for documented CLI/CI execution.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用 Katalon Runtime Engine 执行文档规定的 CLI／CI 测试。

en: Review an editable web recording and negative assertions
Budget local authoring separately from CLI and cloud execution
zh: 审查可编辑网页录制及反例断言
比较停止／继续／可选失败语义
分别预算本地编写、CLI 及云执行

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Select the actual operating system and entitlement
sections.en: The installation guide separates macOS, Windows and Linux and requires a Katalon account and compatible environment. Its Linux steps specify OpenJDK 21. Windows package location and write permissions affect startup. Choose the supported release and platform requirements before importing a working project; a generic download does not establish browser, mobile-device or desktop-test prerequisites. No package or system configuration was changed.
sections.zh: 安装指南分开 macOS、Windows 及 Linux，要求 Katalon 账户和兼容环境；Linux 步骤指定 OpenJDK 21。Windows 包位置及写入权限会影响启动。导入现有项目之前应选受支持发布版及平台要求，下载本身不证明浏览器、移动设备或桌面测试前提满足。本次未修改包或系统配置。

sections.title_en: Recorded actions need assertions and maintained objects
sections.title_zh: 录制动作需要断言及对象维护
sections.en: The quick guide creates a project, captures web actions and objects, adds verification, and groups cases into a suite. A recording provides an editable path through one state, not automatic coverage of all outcomes. For evaluation, use a synthetic flow with an explicit expected result and a deliberately invalid input. Review the stored object locators and target environment before replaying actions that write data. The public demo was not accessed.
sections.zh: 快速指南先创建项目、捕获网页动作及对象、增加验证，再将用例放入套件。录制提供某状态下可编辑路径，不自动覆盖所有结果。评估应采用有明确预期和故意无效输入的虚构流程，重放写数据动作前检查存储对象定位及目标环境。本次未访问公共演示。

sections.title_en: Continue does not mean the failure became optional
sections.title_zh: 继续执行不等于失败变为可选
sections.en: Stop on Failure stops with a failed step; Continue on Failure continues while retaining Failed status; Optional continues with Warning. Select the intended meaning for each check. Changing the project default only affects newly created steps, leaving existing steps unchanged until edited. Inspect an imported or older suite explicitly instead of assuming a new project setting rewrote its historical behavior.
sections.zh: Stop on Failure 以失败步骤停止；Continue on Failure 继续但保留 Failed；Optional 则继续并标 Warning。需为各检查选择预期语义。更改项目默认只影响新建步骤，已有步骤需另外编辑。导入或旧套件应明确检查，不能假定新项目设置已改写旧行为。

sections.title_en: Studio, Runtime Engine and cloud execution are separate choices
sections.title_zh: Studio、Runtime Engine 及云执行是不同选择
sections.en: Runtime Engine is the add-on for command-line automation, including CI, scheduling and container-based execution. The quick guide separately requires a cloud-execution subscription or trial for its remote-browser path. A local Studio run does not establish that a headless pipeline has the necessary license, runtime or device capacity. Validate the exact entry point, test project and execution environment before adopting it in CI.
sections.zh: Runtime Engine 是命令行自动化附加项，用于 CI、调度及容器执行。快速指南另要求云执行订阅或试用才可走远端浏览器路径。本地 Studio 运行不证明无界面流水线已具备许可、运行时及设备容量。用于 CI 前应验证具体入口、测试项目及执行环境。

sections.en: The Katalon True secrets guide limits its reusable vault to cloud-hosted test runs. Matching keys override Studio global variables at execution; readable variables differ from encrypted, masked secrets. Saved values are not editable in place, and secret values are not shown again. This is not evidence of the same vault behavior in a local-only Studio run. Confirm project scope and required keys using non-sensitive placeholders first.
sections.zh: Katalon True secret 指南将可复用保险库限定在云托管测试运行。执行时同名键覆写 Studio 全局变量，可读变量与加密／掩码 secret 不同。保存值不能原地编辑，secret 也不再显示。不能据此推断纯本地 Studio 行为相同，应先用非敏感占位值核项目范围及必要键。

sections.title_en: Test reports do not undo test side effects
sections.title_zh: 测试报告不会撤销测试副作用
sections.en: The quick guide generates reports after execution and describes optional integration that uploads reports to Katalon True. Keep the project version, execution target, input data and failed-step context together when diagnosing a regression. Report availability is not a restore mechanism for records a test created or deleted. Plan fixtures and cleanup against the actual application, and confirm where artifacts are sent before handling sensitive content.
sections.zh: 快速指南在执行后生成报告，并介绍可选集成向 Katalon True 上传报告。排查回归时应一起保留项目版本、执行目标、输入及失败步骤上下文。报告可用不是恢复测试新建或删除记录的机制。应按真实应用规划样本和清理，处理敏感内容前确认产物流向。

sections.title_en: A temporary seat offer is not the standing price
sections.title_zh: 临时席位优惠不是长期价格
sections.en: The pricing page displays Professional at $1,000/seat/year for the first three seats and first online purchase, with an October 31 deadline. It separately presents Free local authoring/execution and a thirty-day paid-feature trial. CLI/CI requires Runtime Engine add-ons, and enterprise controls are custom-priced. Confirm current eligibility and recurring renewal terms rather than normalizing the temporary offer into an unconditional monthly subscription.
sections.zh: 价格页显示 Professional 每席位每年 $1,000，限定前三席位及首次线上购买，截止十月三十一日。另有 Free 本地编写／执行及三十天付费功能试用。CLI／CI 要求 Runtime Engine 附加项，企业控制定制报价。应确认当前资格及续期条款，不能将临时优惠归一化为无条件月费。
